  <li><strong>Electoral Reform:</strong> The Congress party has proposed a 25-year freeze on Lok Sabha seat strength while advocating for the implementation of a 33 percent women’s quota starting in 2029.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Vande Mataram Controversy:</strong> The BJP has criticized the Congress Working Committee’s resolution to limit the singing of Vande Mataram to two stanzas, labeling the party’s stance as divisive and anti-national.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Infrastructure Development:</strong> The Union government, through a committee chaired by Prime Minister Modi, has approved three major development projects in Odisha with an investment of Rs 7,221 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Party Organization:</strong> The BJP is undergoing a leadership reshuffle, sparking internal and external debate regarding the shifting power dynamics within the party’s organizational structure.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
</ul>
